[Story]
Xiaoliu and Xiaoming are good friends, they like mountain climbing and exploring. They plan a new outdoor activity. At this time, Xiaoliu thinks about whether to invite Xiaoyun, who likes mountain biking, to join the journey. Xiaoliu looks at Xiaoming, signals him to look at Xiaoyun with his eyes, and then shakes his head with a smile. Then, he throws an expectant look at Xiaoming, as if hinting at something. Xiaoming watches this process, seems to understand Xiaoliu's intention, so he decides to actively talk to Xiaoyun about this activity. Xiaoming and Xiaoyun talk for a few minutes, Xiaoyun hesitates at first, then nods.

[Question]
Why does Xiaoliu shake his head at Xiaoming, and then throw an expectant look?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Xiaoliu wants to let Xiaoming know that they need to do more preparation work.
B. Xiaoliu hints to Xiaoming that he does not want Xiaoyun to join this activity.
C. The secret actions between Xiaoliu and Xiaoming are about other things.
D. Xiaoliu wants Xiaoming to invite Xiaoyun to participate in the activity.
